title: Shot Runner
user: Small animation teams and technical artists who need repeatable preview renders for named shots without driving a browser UI or maintaining a full studio pipeline.
smallest_useful_product: Local CLI reading a shot manifest, invoking allowlisted renderer commands, caching frame sequences, producing contact sheets and a JSON receipt with source hash/fps/colorspace.
success_measure: A pilot renders five named shots from one command and can reproduce a selected preview bit-for-bit after a clean checkout.
constraints: Never execute commands from untrusted manifests without confirmation; clearly surface renderer licensing and local ffmpeg requirements; store no media remotely.
